declarations.description:
A site-header shell that arranges branding, navigation, actions and an optional mobile trigger. Navigation behaviour
remains the responsibility of slotted controls such as `c2-navigation-menu`.
declarations.name: Header

cssProperties.description: Constrains the inner content while the header surface remains full-width.
cssProperties.name: --c2-header__content--max-width

cssParts.description: Inner layout container that constrains and aligns the header content.
cssParts.name: content

cssParts.description: Primary navigation landmark containing the default slot.
cssParts.name: navigation

slots.description: Logo, product name or home link.
slots.name: brand

slots.description: Account and application actions aligned to the end.
slots.name: actions

slots.description: Responsive navigation trigger, placed after the actions.
slots.name: mobile-trigger

members.name: sticky
members.description: Pins the header to the configured top offset.

members.name: blurred
members.description: Uses a translucent background and backdrop filter.

members.name: navigationLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the primary navigation landmark.
